summary: Four Corners Property Trust (FCPT) filed an 8-K disclosing its entry into a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire up to 102 veterinary properties from Shore Capital Real Estate Partners for up to $268 million. The properties are net-leased to Mission Pet Health with a ~10-year weighted average remaining term. An initial $4 million deposit was made. The transaction is subject to due diligence and customary closing conditions. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The deal is structured as a portfolio acquisition under master leases. Watch for completion of due diligence and satisfaction of closing conditions; risk-arb uncertainty revolves around the contingent nature of the acquisition.
